date.description: First-of-month label for the source monthly mean; local audit reports original NetCDF timestamp at 00:30, absent from CSV.

longitude.description: Native coarse-grid longitude, east positive; keep both cells separate.

SPEED.description: Monthly mean surface wind speed; height not separately verified as 10 m.

EVAP.description: Monthly mean evaporation_from_turbulence; signs preserved; not crop water demand, ETc, or irrigation requirement.

EFLUX.description: Monthly mean total_latent_energy_flux; source signs retained without reassignment.

HFLUX.description: Monthly mean sensible_heat_flux_from_turbulence; source signs retained without reassignment.

x-dataset.temporal_grain: Source monthly mean × native grid cell
x-dataset.spatial_grain: Separate coarse MERRA-2 native cells; one latitude row and two longitudes

provenance.transformation: Byte-for-byte copy of an existing validated CSV; no aggregation, imputation, conversion, or rounding.

requirements: Exact ordered source columns and declared CSV types.
Unique, non-null natural key within the declared spatial scope.
Finite numeric values, declared ranges, exact coverage and missing counts.
Source and output records identical, including order, precision and null markers.
Source/output/schema SHA-256 values and manifest metadata agree.
Dataset-specific calendar, denominator, quality and unit-consistency checks.

warnings: Optional supporting context only; never a primary decision-driving source.
Two coarse cells at latitude 42.0 and longitudes -93.75/-93.125 remain separate; not a county-wide average or field-scale surface.
EVAP is not crop water demand, ETc, or irrigation requirement. EFLUX/HFLUX are not direct crop-stress measurements.
TSH is absent; Var_TSH is excluded, never a temperature substitute. PRECCON/PRECSNO remain deferred.
Coverage begins June 2008, so 2008 is partial. Signs and native flux-rate units are preserved; no flux conversions are added.

x-csv.note: NULL and empty cells decode to JSON null only in nullable fields. Identifiers such as mukey stay strings. Units=null means not applicable or not separately verified.
